name: Drop Stack Block Stacking Game
dev: App Family Kids - Learning games for boys & girls

android.desc:
Drop Stack is a free endless block tower stacking physics game. Are you ready to stack blocks, test your skills and see how high you can build your tower?

With its simple yet challenging gameplay, Drop Stack is a fun and relaxing casual game that will keep you entertained for hours on end. Your mission is to stack as many blocks as possible on top of each other without letting them fall. Stack the blocks densely if going for score, or drop blocks into narrow towers if going for the tallest tower. How many blocks can you stack before your block tower crumbles?

With each block you stack, the tower gets higher and the challenge gets harder. Balance is the key, and you must strategize your moves and think ahead to prevent your tower from collapsing. Knowing when and where to drop blocks will allow you to stack them up into the tallest block towers. Line up the block, then tap to drop blocks where they fit best.The graphics are relaxing and the physics engine is realistic, making each block feel like it has its own weight and momentum. The controls are super simple and easy to learn, so you can focus on building your tower without any distractions.

Drop Stack is a free offline stacking physics game and fun for both kids and adults - perfect for anyone looking for a quick game on the go or an intense challenge to test their skills. Whether you're a casual player or a gaming pro, Drop Stack is the perfect game to help you unwind and relax.

Features:
- Simple controls
- Build a tower as tall as possible or use as many blocks as possible
- Play three difficulty levels
- Unlock new block colors
- Keep track of your highscore
- Play offline without Internet
- App updated for 2024

So what are you waiting for? Download Drop Stack today and see if you have what it takes to become the ultimate tower builder!

For more relaxing puzzle games try out our other fun and free apps for kids and adults!

Music: Kevin MacLeod (Incompetech)
